_description: Shared conformance vectors for the revocation_witness Noir circuit and the HarpocratesRegistry Soroban contract (#98). Both the Noir tests (nargo test) and the Rust contract tests use these same fixtures to prevent drift.

positive_cases.name: valid_non_revocation_witness
positive_cases.description: Credential 12345 is NOT in the revocation tree — proof should succeed

positive_cases.name: zero_credential_secret_non_revocation
positive_cases.description: Zero credential secret is not revoked

positive_cases.name: max_field_non_revocation
positive_cases.description: Maximum BN254 field value is not revoked

positive_cases.name: empty_revocation_tree
positive_cases.description: Tree with all zero leaves — any credential passes

positive_cases.name: full_tree_non_member
positive_cases.description: Tree has 8 unique revoked leaves — a non-member still passes

negative_cases.name: wrong_credential_secret
negative_cases.description: Private secret doesn't match the public credential_root

negative_cases.name: wrong_nullifier_secret
negative_cases.description: Private nullifier_secret doesn't match the public nullifier

negative_cases.name: revoked_credential
negative_cases.description: Credential 33333 IS in the revocation tree (leaf 1)

negative_cases.name: credential_at_leaf_seven
negative_cases.description: Credential IS at the last leaf position

negative_cases.name: tampered_revocation_root
negative_cases.description: Public revocation_root is zero instead of the real tree root

negative_cases.name: tampered_leaves
negative_cases.description: A leaf is altered so the computed tree root changes

contract_boundary_cases.name: check_non_revocation_succeeds
contract_boundary_cases.description: Valid proof with correct root, domain, credential, and fresh nullifier

contract_boundary_cases.name: rejects_wrong_root
contract_boundary_cases.description: Proof's revocation_root differs from stored on-chain root

contract_boundary_cases.name: rejects_revoked_credential
contract_boundary_cases.description: Credential root has been revoked via revoke_credential_root

contract_boundary_cases.name: rejects_reused_nullifier
contract_boundary_cases.description: Same nullifier submitted twice — replay attack prevented
